description: This file defines onboarding-related states, connection modes, and functions to manage onboarding flow using UserDefaults. It includes enum definitions, state checks, and flags for onboarding completion and first-run intro display.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be presented when the app launches based on onboarding state and previous connection configuration.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed; optionally records the last connection mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run intro has not been seen yet.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks the first run intro as seen.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding state to incomplete and clears flags.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode used during onboarding, if available.
